subject: Re: SavantHealth MSA / Order Form - DPA role mapping and final steps
messages:
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@savanthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@savanthealth.com>, legalops@savanthealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on DPA redlines and role matrix

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending the MSA and order form. Our legal team reviewed the DPA redlines and had three items we need clarified before we can route to procurement:

1) Controller / Processor roles in section 2 — Savant needs explicit confirmation that Redwood will act as processor for Customer Data and that any processing for product analytics will be covered by the same scope.

2) SCCs — we noted that Redwood's suggested SCCs are the 2021 EU Commission clauses. We need confirmation on cross-border protections and whether you will accept the supplementary transfer addendum we use for health data (attached separately).

3) Subprocessor list and notification timeline — procurement expects a CSV of current subprocessors and an SLA for notice (30 days preferred).

Can you loop in your privacy/legal lead so we can get firm language? We are on a tight procurement window and would like to close by end of next week if possible.

Best,
Emily Ross
Senior Counsel, Savant Health
emily.ross@savanthealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@savanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on DPA redlines and role matrix

Emily —

Appreciate the clear list. Looping in Ben (Legal Ops) and Laura (Head of Privacy) to address these precisely. Quick responses to your bullets so procurement has visibility:

- Roles: Redwood confirms it will be Processor for Customer Data under the MSA/Order Form. Any telemetry used for product analytics will be detailed in the subprocessor annex and will be scoped out of PHI unless explicitly listed in the order form.

- SCCs: We use the 2021 SCCs. Laura will confirm compatibility with your health-data addendum and propose language for a transfer impact addendum if required.

- Subprocessors: Attached is a current inventory CSV; we can commit to a 30-day notice for material additions and a quarterly published update for changes.

We will prepare a short candidate redline set and a one-page summary you can share with procurement.

Thanks — will follow up with the redline within 24 hours.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Savant DPA touchpoints and proposed positions

Team — notes from my review and recommended positions for the redline we will send:

1) Roles clause: Accept 'Processor' label. Add explicit sentence: "Redwood acts as Processor for Customer Data processed on behalf of Customer under the Order Form; any processing for service improvement/analytics will be aggregated and pseudonymized unless otherwise agreed." Keeps us flexible while addressing their PHI concerns.

2) SCCs / Transfer Addendum: Accept 2021 SCCs + offer a 'transfer impact addendum' where we indicate our hosting regions, subprocessors, and mitigation steps. We should not accept bespoke contract language that amends SCC technical guarantees (pushback point).

3) Subprocessors: Provide current CSV and commit to 30-day notice for new subprocessors with an exception for emergency security vendors (we'll notify "as soon as practicable").

4) Evidence: Provide SOC 2 snapshot (read-only), KMS/hardware boundary note, and our subprocessor attestation. We should attach SOC2 and subprocessor inventory to the outbound redline email.

Jordan: please prepare the order-form appendix language clarifying data categories (PHI vs. Product Usage). Laura: please confirm phrasing on "pseudonymized" and tooling safeguards.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Savant DPA touchpoints and proposed positions

Ben / team — agree with the approach. Minor tweaks below:

- Pseudonymization language: suggest we say "irreversibly pseudonymized for analytics" only where we can confirm no re-identification keys are retained. For any case where re-identification is required (rare), it must be by written agreement.

- Transfer impact addendum: I'll draft a short annex listing hosting regions (us-west-2, us-east-1) and high-level mitigations (encryption at rest/in-transit, contractual SCCs). I'll also confirm that the 2021 SCCs are our standard and that we cannot materially alter the SCC operative text.

- Evidence package: SOC 2 (summary + scope note), current subprocessor CSV, and a short KMS diagram should be fine. Recommend we mark the SOC2 as "redacted snapshot" for sharing.

I'll have the annex + suggested DPA redline by EOD.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@savanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@savanthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed DPA redline and evidence for Savant Health (attachments)

Emily / Tom —

Attached: Redwood_DPA-redline-20260212.docx (tracked changes), SOC2-snapshot-2025-12.pdf (redacted), subprocessor-inventory-20260210.csv. Key callouts in the redline:

• Roles: We confirm Processor status; added sentence clarifying analytics pseudonymization and re-identification constraints.
• SCCs: We keep 2021 SCCs; added a short Transfer Impact Addendum (Annex B) that lists regions and mitigations. We are not able to accept edits to the SCC operative clauses, but will accept the annex language you provided as a supplemental statement of measures.

• Subprocessors / Notice: Committed to 30 days for routine additions; emergency vendors will be notified "as soon as practicable" and logged in the quarterly subprocessor publication.

Next steps we propose:
1) If Savant legal agrees to the tracked changes, we can issue a final clean DPA and send to DocuSign (link included).
2) If they have specific wording in Annex B they'd like merged, they can mark their changes directly in the attached docx.

We are aiming to get the fully executed MSA + DPA by close of day Friday (2026-02-13). Please let us know any blocking redlines by tomorrow EOD so we can prioritize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_DPA-redline-20260212.docx (docx/tracked), SOC2-snapshot-2025-12.pdf (pdf/redacted), subprocessor-inventory-20260210.csv (csv)
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@savanthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@savanthealth.com>, legalops@savanthealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed DPA redline and evidence for Savant Health (attachments)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. We reviewed the tracked changes with procurement and have two minor asks:

1) Annex B (Transfer Impact Addendum) — can you add a short paragraph clarifying "data residency commitments" for the Order Form scope: Savant will be able to restrict processing to US regions for the initial pilot; add a mechanism for re-evaluating region restrictions at renewal.

2) Emergency subprocessor exception — procurement accepts "as soon as practicable" for notification, but legal asks for an internal SLA: Redwood to notify within 5 business days of any emergency onboarding that materially impacts processing locations or subprocessors handling PHI.

If you agree to both, procurement is comfortable with a DocuSign push and we can get the signature by EOD Friday.

—Emily
Emily Ross
Senior Counsel, Savant Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@savanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@savanthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed DPA redline and evidence for Savant Health (attachments)

Emily / team —

Agree to both asks. Summary of final edits we will make right now:

• Annex B: add "data residency commitments" paragraph — pilot scope limited to US regions (us-west-2 / us-east-1); review at renewal or upon written request with 30 days' notice.
• Emergency onboarding: add SLA clause to notify Savant within 5 business days when an emergency subprocessor materially affects processing locations or PHI handling, with a post-event summary of mitigations.

Ben and Laura will incorporate these two items and re-issue the clean DPA to DocuSign. We will use the provided DocuSign link and target execution by EOD today per Savant procurement's note. Once signed, I'll coordinate onboarding and the quarterly subprocessor update cadence.

Thanks all — nice to get this across the finish line.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
